sections.p: Your GharBasket wallet can be spent only on GharBasket orders. It holds up to ₹10,000. You can't withdraw cash or send money to someone else. Unused money goes back to the account you paid from, on request.

Autopilot plans each week. You can change, skip or pause until the cut-off at 9 PM the day before delivery. At the cut-off the box is paid from your wallet; if the wallet is short you have until 11 PM to top up, or the week is cancelled with no charge.
Points are not money. They expire, and you can use them as a discount on a box.
Tiffins come from verified home kitchens and boxes come through your Society Captain. Report any problem from Orders.
Your phone number, address, who eats at home (age groups, not birth dates) and your food rules. Health needs only if you turn them on. We never ask for Aadhaar.
To plan, pack and deliver your box. Each optional use, like WhatsApp updates or health planning, has its own switch, recorded with the date you chose.
Health tags are never shared with cooks, riders or captains. Your captain sees your flat and your box, not your health or payments.
From Profile › Privacy and data you can download your data or delete your account. Deleted accounts are removed within 30 days; money records stay without your name, as the law needs.
